preset.caption: Isolated acoustic drum kit accompaniment. A restrained, natural groove with kick, snare and closed hi-hat, following the piano performance timing, phrasing and dynamics. Clear drum hits, tasteful fills and space between phrases. Drums only, no vocals or melodic instruments.

preservation_scope: Original uploaded result ZIP preserves stereo 32kHz PCM16 drum and mix WAVs; feedback ZIP preserves previews, actual settings and FP32 capture.
scope_limit: Approval applies to this 30-second opening excerpt only. Other song sections and long contexts are not validated. No audio retiming applied.
